title: order.fact.shipment_registered v1 payload
description: ADR-0011 O1 — Ordering-owned fact that a parcel is fully described, labelled where required, and ready for the journey. Shipment consumes this to open its own aggregate; from that point Shipment is the sole lifecycle writer (ADR-0003). The receiver's phone, name and street address are not published: routing needs the governorate, and the rest stays behind Ordering's API.

request_id.description: ShipmentRequest aggregate id; MUST equal envelope aggregate_id.

tracking_code.description: The code printed on the label and texted to the receiver.

sender_kind.description: Decides which v6.3 rules apply: a customer parcel has no COD and no pickup (p.8).

merchant_id.description: Present only when sender_kind is MERCHANT.

destination_governorate.description: The routing unit. v6.3 p.12 makes this mandatory; the street address is not.

label_code.description: The pre-printed label the merchant scanned onto the parcel. Null on the customer path, where hub staff label at drop-off.

cod_amount_minor_units.description: Exact minor units. Never a decimal or a formatted string.

requires_pickup.description: False for every customer parcel — regular customers do not get a pickup (v6.3 p.8, p.15).

description.description: Required by v6.3 p.12 so a parcel is never registered as an unknown item.

sender_kind.description: A regular customer's parcel has no COD option (v6.3 p.8).
